subtitle.login: Use the account name and password of your account.
subtitle.register: Signing up needs an email address and a 6-digit verification code; you'll be signed in automatically afterwards.

sendCode.sent: Verification code sent — check your inbox

field.nicknameHint: Optional; defaults to your account name if left empty.

firstLogin.title: This device already has data — how should it merge with the cloud?

desc.noCloud: This account has no data in the cloud yet.
desc.askOnce: You'll only be asked this once, at first sign-in.

merge.title: Upload local data (merge)
merge.description: Local records are uploaded; where the same record was updated in the cloud, the cloud version still wins. Recommended.

cloud.title: Use the cloud version
cloud.description: Clears local projects and chats, then rebuilds from the cloud. Unsynced local changes will be lost.

localOnly.title: Skip syncing for now
localOnly.description: Skips the cloud this time and keeps data on this device; you can trigger a sync manually in "Sync" later.

firstLogin.footer: You'll be asked again when you sign in on a new device; on the same device it's asked only once.

account.title: Account
account.description: Sign in to use the same account everywhere; data is stored locally per account.
account.credentialsHint: Your sign-in credentials are stored only in this browser.

profile.title: Personal background
profile.description: When a new blank node is created, this text is injected into the system prompt as context.
profile.placeholder: e.g. Third-year CS student preparing for the graduate entrance exam in math; please give full derivations and counterexamples, and don't skip intermediate steps.

footer.authenticated: Settings, projects, nodes and chats sync with your account; image assets and review sessions stay on this device and don't carry over to other devices.
footer.guest: Projects, nodes, chats and images are stored in the browser's IndexedDB and are lost if you clear browser data; sign in to sync them to your account.

sync.description: Settings and learning projects sync to your account; BYOK API keys and local review sessions (the unfinished batch) stay on this device.
